All panels are produced by
[`script/FigureS10.R`](https://github.com/dzemmour/immgenT-cosmo-paper/blob/main/script/FigureS10.R).
The code below is shown for reference (not re-executed on this page); the
images are its pre-rendered output.

## Setup

```{r figs10-setup, code=code_for("../script/FigureS10.R", c("^", "Load data")), eval=FALSE}
```

## (A) Most lineage-specific transcription factors {#figs10a}

```{r figs10a-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS10.R", "S10a"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs10a-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="55%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure10/S10a_heatmap_TF_top20_lineage.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 10A.** Heatmap showing log1p(CP10K) expression of the 20
most specific transcription factors across T-cell lineages, ranked by the
specificity score of [Figure 8a](Figure8.html#fig8a). Columns are fixed in
lineage order rather than clustered.
:::

## (B) Most cluster-specific transcription factors {#figs10b}

```{r figs10b-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS10.R", "S10b"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs10b-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="90%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure10/S10b_heatmap_TF_top20_cluster.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 10B.** The same for the 20 most specific transcription
factors across immgenT clusters, columns in lineage order, with annotation bars
for lineage and activation status.
:::

## (C-F) Selected transcription factors {#figs10cf}

```{r figs10cf-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS10.R", "S10c-S10f"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs10cf-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="49%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c(
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure10/S10c_barplot_Sox4.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure10/S10d_barplot_Zbtb32.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure10/S10e_barplot_Tshz2.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure10/S10f_barplot_Hlf.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 10C-F.** Bar plots showing average expression of Sox4 (C),
Zbtb32 (D), Tshz2 (E) and Hlf (F) across immgenT clusters, coloured by lineage.
:::
